Uses ACUCOBOL-specific syntax: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, USAGE IS COMP-4, CRT STATUS, screen section with Grid/Entry-Field/Label controls, WHEN SET TO FALSE on 88-levels, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian ERP/management system (Geslux) - supplier order solicitation panel. Manages quantities and delivery dates for supplier orders, with grid display of articles, clients, order numbers, quantities and solicitation data.
purpose.summary: This program implements a GUI panel ('Pannello qta solleciti ordini fornitori') for managing supplier order solicitations in an Italian ERP system called Geslux. It reads and processes data from multiple files (articoli/articles, clienti/clients, tordforn/testa ordini fornitori, rordforn/righe ordini fornitori, sordforn/solleciti ordini fornitori) and displays them in a grid with delivery date filtering. The program was generated by the TOTEM RAD code generator.
